title: Normalize Layout Plugin To Consistency Contract
description: Normalize the layout plugin crate (layout/plugin/rs/lib.rs) to the Wave-3 Consistency Contract: adopt SDK PanelKit (tree_item/tree_item_with_action/tree_item_with_action_draggable/PanelTreeBuilder/selection_ids) from semio_framework_plugin instead of local hand-rolled copies; adopt SDK Testkit (meta/new_app/new_app_with_registry/assert_undo_redo_round_trip) instead of local test scaffolding; rename the "🔖️AppFactory" region to "🔖️Manifest" and reorder regions into canonical order (Constants, Types, DocumentHelpers, Terminology, CommandLabels, Panels, Render, App impl, Manifest, Tests); verify C1 naming (app id "layout-play" -> struct "LayoutPlayApp", already compliant) and C4 layout (single-app crate stays flat, already compliant). Do NOT touch the hand-rolled PointerCamera/CanvasScene regions (reserved for a separate Wave-3 agent covering build_canvas_2d_scene consolidation). Mechanical pass only.
summary:
Normalized layout/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the Wave-3 Consistency Contract, mechanical pass only (PointerCamera/CanvasScene left untouched per instructions).

PanelKit (C5): deleted the local tree_item/tree_item_hoverable/selection_ids/catalogue-draggable boilerplate. build_document_tree/build_catalogue_tree/build_preflight_tree now assemble their final UiNode::Tree via semio_framework_plugin::PanelTreeBuilder. Row construction goes through a thin layout_tree_item/layout_tree_item_hoverable wrapper built on top of the SDK's tree_item_desc/tree_item_with_action (kept a distinct name, not shadowing the SDK's own tree_item, since this crate's rows need an icon_id the SDK helpers don't take). catalogue_tree_item now builds its draggable item via tree_item_with_action_draggable. selection_ids is now the SDK's directly (no local copy).

Terminology (C5): replaced the hand-rolled LayoutLabels struct + LAYOUT_LABELS_NATIVE_EN/DE consts + layout_labels() resolver with semio_framework_plugin::app_labels! + resolve_labels::<LayoutLabels>(). Replaced the hand-rolled action-label map with localized_label_map. Replaced the manual AppLabelsOverlay struct literal in DocumentApp::app_labels with the AppLabelsOverlayExt fluent builder (window_kind_label/panel_tab_label/mode_label/action_labels/utility_labels/example_labels — confirmed AppLabelsOverlayExt has no per-field app_label()/dialog/introduction singular setters, only the bulk ones used here). Also swapped the inline is_de locale check for the SDK's is_de_locale(). Two direct test references to LAYOUT_LABELS_NATIVE_EN now read LayoutLabels::EN (the app_labels! macro's generated associated const).

Testkit (C5): deleted the local meta()/new_app()/new_app_with_registry() scaffolding; all ~35 call sites now use semio_framework_plugin::testkit::{new_app::<LayoutPlayApp>(), new_app_with_registry::<LayoutPlayApp>(create_layout_app), meta(...)} directly (matches the pattern already landed in raster/flow). The one test matching the generic undo/redo shape (undo_redo_round_trips_add_frame) now calls testkit::assert_undo_redo_round_trip with an addFrame-count probe; no convergence/idempotency tests existed in this crate to migrate. All other app-specific tests (preflight, patch fields, canvas hit-testing, DWG import, etc.) were left untouched.

C2/C3 regions: renamed "🔖️AppFactory" to "🔖️Manifest" (open+close markers) and moved "🔖️CommandLabels" to sit between Terminology and Panels, giving the canonical order Constants -> Types -> DocumentHelpers -> Terminology -> CommandLabels -> Panels -> Render -> LayoutPlayApp -> Manifest -> Tests. "🧪️Tests" was already correctly named. No "//# region" spacing issues found.

C1 naming: app id "layout-play" already maps to struct "LayoutPlayApp" — no rename needed anywhere in the crate, fixtures, or tests.

C4 layout: single-app crate, already flat (no wrapping mod) — no change needed.

Step 4 (.resource_kind): create_layout_app() already has a correct .resource_kind(ResourceKindSpec { id: "2d.layout", ... }) — verified present and well-formed, no change needed.

Untouched per Wave-3 split: the "🔖️CanvasScene" and "🔖️PointerCamera" sub-regions inside DocumentHelpers (hand-rolled camera/hit-testing/display-list-to-layers code) are reserved for a separate agent's build_canvas_2d_scene consolidation and were left exactly as-is.

Verified: read framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs's real PanelKit/Terminology/Testkit region source before writing any call (no guessed signatures). Exhaustive grep cross-reference of every renamed/removed identifier (tree_item, tree_item_hoverable, selection_ids, LAYOUT_LABELS_NATIVE_EN/DE, meta/new_app/new_app_with_registry, AppFactory) across the whole layout/ directory — zero residue. rustfmt (repo rustfmt.toml, max_width=250) ran to completion and produced only pre-existing style diff (this file was never strictly rustfmt-clean even before this change) with no parse errors, confirming the file is syntactically valid Rust. Manual line-by-line diff review of the full before/after against the ticket-folder backup snapshot. Did NOT get a real `cargo check -p layout-plugin` compile confirmation: the process sat blocked on the shared target lock for the whole session (verified via `ps aux` showing 10+ other concurrent `cargo check` processes from other sessions, matching the documented repo-wide lock contention) and never produced output; left running in the background rather than blocking further. This needs to be covered by the orchestrator's final full `cargo check --workspace` + test sweep.

Note: this ticket was found already closed with an unrelated summary (norm_en_1998/norm_en_1999 seismic-code content) before this close call, apparently from a concurrent session's mistaken write — reopened and re-closed with the correct summary above.
